STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_073455.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_073455.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_073455 (
    SW,
    LEDR,
    LEDG,
    HEX7,
    HEX6,
    HEX5,
    HEX4,
    HEX2,
    HEX1,
    HEX0
);
  input [15:0] SW;
  output [15:0] LEDR;
  output [7:0] LEDG;
  output [7:0] HEX0;
  output [7:0] HEX1;
  output [7:0] HEX2;
  output [7:0] HEX4;
  output [7:0] HEX5;
  output [7:0] HEX6;
  output [7:0] HEX7;

  wire [3:0] S7, S6, S5, S4, S3, S2, S1, S0;
  reg [3:0] invalidNums;

  //HEX displays
  hexDisplay h7 (
      SW[15:12],
      HEX7
  );
  hexDisplay h6 (
      SW[11:8],
      HEX6
  );

  hexDisplay h5 (
      SW[7:4],
      HEX5
  );
  hexDisplay h4 (
      SW[3:0],
      HEX4
  );

  add_2_4bit_nums a1 (
      SW[11:8],
      SW[3:0],
      S1,
      S0
  );

  //put S0 on HEX0

  hexDisplay h0 (
      S0,
      HEX0
  );

  //2
  add_2_4bit_nums a2 (
      SW[15:12],
      S1,
      S3,
      S2
  );

  //3
  add_2_4bit_nums a3 (
      SW[7:4],
      S2,
      S5,
      S4
  );

  hexDisplay h1 (
      S4,
      HEX1
  );

  //4
  add_2_4bit_nums a4 (
      S5,
      S3,
      S7,
      S6
  );

  hexDisplay h2 (
      S6,
      HEX2
  );

  assign LEDR = SW;

  //If any of the four input numbers is invalid a corresponding LEDG will be illuminated
  always @(SW) begin
    if (SW[15:12] > 4'b1001) begin
      invalidNums[3] = 1;
    end else invalidNums[3] = 0;
    if (SW[11:8] > 4'b1001) begin
      invalidNums[2] = 1;
    end else invalidNums[2] = 0;
    if (SW[7:4] > 4'b1001) begin
      invalidNums[1] = 1;
    end else invalidNums[1] = 0;
    if (SW[3:0] > 4'b1001) begin
      invalidNums[0] = 1;
    end else invalidNums[0] = 0;
  end

  assign LEDG[3:0] = invalidNums;
endmodule
